verdict.rationale: The docs show a project-local path: `ultrametric init` writes skill files into the project for Codex and Claude Code, and those files can be committed to share with the team. The only global element is the CLI binary itself (`npm install -g`). There is no documented way to choose between project-local and user-global installation of the skills or instructions. Missing for 10: an explicit install-scope selection (e.g. a --global/--project flag), user-global skill or instruction installation across all projects, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
